facts.text: Experimental gene therapy **CRMA-1001** silences **hepatitis B** viral DNA by **methylation** (epigenetics), using **CRISPR-Cas9** as locator, delivered on an **mRNA** platform; in mice 90% had undetectable viral DNA after three doses — a 'functional cure'. A phase I/II trial is under way (*Nature Biomedical Engineering*).

facts.text: **MoRTH** amended the **Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989** (Rule 115) to allow **E100** (pure ethanol) and **E85**, only in **flex-fuel vehicles** made by manufacturers; this eases **homologation** (type approval by agencies like **ARAI**). Existing vehicles need not switch.

facts.text: India hit **E20** (20% ethanol blending) in **2025**, five years ahead of the 2030 target of the **National Policy on Biofuels, 2018**; from **April 2026** all petrol sold must be E20. MeitY advisories of **8 and 10 Oct** (the second to **Meta**) preceded a wave of takedowns amid anti-CEC protests.

facts.text: Users whose posts are removed under a platform's own rules must go to its **grievance officer**, then the government's **Grievance Appellate Committee** (30 days). In **Shreya Singhal v Union of India (2015)** the SC struck down **Section 66A** but upheld 69A.
